TC-14/S26.title: Generate, leave for another chart at once and come straight back: a generating state while the call runs, then the note (dev, real backend)
TC-14/S26.detail: Dataset gen-ac15 on dev (live Haiku). Hospital: back on the chart 3.7 s after the press while the note was still being written: Post-Round showed 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' and the spinning 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' button, no generating state (FAILED); the note then appeared without a reload (passed; the page that started it was still alive). Nursing Home: the note (Haiku, 3.2 s) was already there when the physician came back at 4.3 s, so the generating state could not be observed (recorded); the note was on Post-Round (passed). The failure half (cell F) cannot be forced on dev (no fault injection); it is judged locally (failed). Timings recorded: notes.generateNote 4.0 s (Hospital) / 3.2 s (Nursing Home), providerMs within 6 ms of the total.
TC-14/S26.productIssue: Coming back to a chart whose note is still being written shows 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' instead of a generating state; the physician may press Generate again or think the dictation was lost.
